At the beginning, the remote-controlled helicopter hovers directly above point C. ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, it can be seen that a camera is suspended by a light rope below the remote-control helicopter; the light rope is deflected relative to the vertical direction, and the angle is marked as β; the rope tension on the camera is obliquely upward along the direction of the rope. The problem states that the mass of the camera is m, its gravity is mg, directed vertically downward; the force of the air on the camera is always horizontal, so the air force has no vertical component. Perform a force analysis on the camera. In the vertical direction the camera has no vertical acceleration, so the forces in the vertical direction are balanced. The vertical component of the tension F_T in the rope is F_T cosβ, balancing the gravity mg, therefore F_T cosβ = mg. Solving gives F_T = mg/cosβ.

method.method_draft: 把摄像机作为研究对象作受力分析：从图中或题意确认轻绳相对竖直方向偏角为 β，绳中拉力 F_T 沿绳方向斜向上；题文给出摄像机质量为 m，重力为 mg 竖直向下，空气作用力始终水平。由于空气力没有竖直分量，摄像机竖直方向无加速度，竖直方向受力平衡：F_T cosβ = mg。解得 F_T = mg/cosβ。
method.CoT_raw: 图像中可见遥控直升机下方用轻绳悬挂摄像机，轻绳相对竖直方向偏转，夹角标为 β；摄像机受到的绳拉力沿绳方向斜向上。题意给出摄像机质量为 m，重力为 mg，方向竖直向下；空气对摄像机的作用力始终水平，因此空气力没有竖直分量。对摄像机作受力分析，在竖直方向上摄像机无竖直加速度，所以竖直方向受力平衡。绳中拉力 F_T 的竖直分量为 F_T cosβ，平衡重力 mg，因此 F_T cosβ = mg。解得 F_T = mg/cosβ。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 使用受力分析和牛顿第二定律在竖直方向的应用：水平空气力无竖直分量，竖直方向平衡时拉力竖直分量等于重力，即 F_T cosβ=mg。
